chunks: So the Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad al-Ashʿarī, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Abān, from one who informed him, from Abū Jaʿfar and Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليهما السلام, who said:
“The menstruating woman makes up the fasting, and she does not make up the salat (prayer).”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the ritual prayer that is not made up in this case
key_terms.الصِّيَامَ: the obligatory fasts missed during menstruation
key_terms.الْحَائِضُ: a woman in the state of menstruation
key_terms.تَقْضِي: she makes up an act of worship after its time has passed

ai.seo_question: Does a menstruating woman make up missed fasting and prayer in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling that a menstruating woman must make up missed sawm (fasting) but is not required to make up missed salat (prayer). It is a concise jurisprudential report concerning the rulings of menstruation and acts of worship.
